settings.prefill_definition: prompt forward, first-token selection, output/cache capture and sequence bookkeeping, then CUDA synchronize
settings.decode_definition: remaining N-1 tokens, including forward, selection and sequence bookkeeping, then CUDA synchronize
settings.total_definition: contiguous wall-clock interval covering prefill and decode; includes phase-boundary synchronization
settings.kv_size_definition: sum of numel * element_size over final retained K and V tensors, excluding allocator overhead
settings.eos_policy: mask EOS on every generation step, matching min_new_tokens=max_new_tokens=N
